response.sql:
WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    maj.department,
    COUNT(m.member_id) as member_count
  FROM member m
  INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
  GROUP BY maj.department
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(member_count) as total_members,
    COUNT(*) as num_departments
  FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT 
  dc.department,
  dc.member_count,
  CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members as share,
  CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members - 1.0 / t.num_departments as diff_from_avg
FROM dept_counts dc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members > 1.0 / t.num_departments
ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Only departments with at least one member are included in the average calculation. Departments with zero members are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Include all departments in the major table, even those with zero members, in the average share calculation. This changes the denominator for the average (1/num_departments will include departments with no members).

  GROUP BY maj.department
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(member_count) as total_members,
    COUNT(*) as num_departments
  FROM dept_counts
)
SELECT 
  dc.department,
  dc.member_count,
  CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members as share,
  CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members - 1.0 / t.num_departments as diff_from_avg
FROM dept_counts dc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE t.total_members > 0 AND CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_members > 1.0 / t.num_departments
ORDER BY share DESC
